title: Book 7 DRILL: whole book
subtitle: H2 Biology 9477 · Book 7 · 8 questions · 90 marks · every stem a real exam question · all fourteen outcomes, 4(a) to 4(n)
los_html: Every question here is a real exam paper question at its own mark allocation, lifted as the paper sets it, with its verbatim mark scheme. Four of the eight are Paper 3 Section B essays, which is where this book is actually examined. Between them they cover all fourteen outcomes, 4(a) to 4(n). A note under each mark scheme says which outcomes it carries and why that question was chosen. Read 1a - STUDY SHEET - Book 7 first.
